parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
alliance[əˈlaɪəns]n.
An alliance is a group of people who work together. (Liên minh là một nhóm người làm việc cùng nhau.)
→ The junior executives formed an alliance with each other.
😎
applause[əˈplɔːz]n.
Applause is the noise made when people clap hands to show approval. (Tiếng vỗ tay là âm thanh tạo ra khi mọi người vỗ tay để thể hiện sự tán thành.)
→ At the end of his speech, everyone gave applause.
😎
armed[ɑːrmd]adj.
If you are armed, you are carrying a weapon. (Nếu bạn được vũ trang, bạn đang mang theo vũ khí.)
→ The robber was armed with a gun.
😎
authoritative[əˈθɔːrəteɪtɪv]adj.
If something is authoritative, it uses the best information available. (Nếu một thứ gì đó có tính thẩm quyền, nó sử dụng thông tin tốt nhất có sẵn.)
→ This book is an authoritative source on Ancient Egypt’s Queen Nefertiti.
😎
ceremony[ˈserəmoʊni]n.
A ceremony is an event that happens on special occasions. (Một buổi lễ là một sự kiện diễn ra vào những dịp đặc biệt.)
→ Tom and Amy’s marriage ceremony is in June.
😎
culture[ˈkʌltʃər]n.
Culture is the music, art, and writings of a certain place or group of people. (Văn hóa là âm nhạc, nghệ thuật và chữ viết của một địa phương hoặc một nhóm người nhất định.)
→ Ancient Mexican culture is renowned for its architecture.
😎
defense[dɪˈfens]n.
A defense is something that is done to protect another thing. (Phòng thủ là một việc được thực hiện để bảo vệ một thứ khác.)
→ The airforce works in defense of its country.
😎
detail[ˈdiːteɪl]n.
A detail is a small piece of information. (Chi tiết là một mẩu thông tin nhỏ.)
→ Jane told Ben all the details of her trip to China.
😎
diverse[dɪˈvɜːrs]adj.
When a group of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things. (Khi một nhóm có tính đa dạng, nó được tạo thành từ nhiều thứ khác nhau.)
→ Big cities have diverse populations with people of different races and ages.
😎
enchant[ɪnˈtʃænt]v.
To enchant someone is to make them feel very interested or happy. (Mê hoặc ai đó là làm cho họ cảm thấy rất thích thú hoặc vui vẻ.)
→ The beautiful woman enchanted everybody in the room.
😎
equip[ɪˈkwɪp]v.
To equip someone is to give them the things needed to do something. (Trang bị cho ai đó là cung cấp cho họ những thứ cần thiết để làm việc gì đó.)
→ Steve was equipped with the tools needed to do the job.
😎
exception[ɪkˈsepʃn]n.
An exception is someone or something not conforming to a rule. (Ngoại lệ là người hoặc điều gì đó không tuân theo một quy tắc chung.)
→ Most students thought the test was hard, but Tim was the exception.
😎
genre[ˈʒɑːnrə]n.
A genre is a type of literature, art, or music characterized by its style. (Thể loại là một loại hình văn học, nghệ thuật hoặc âm nhạc đặc trưng bởi phong cách của nó.)
→ She is considered a master in the comedy genre.
😎
impact[ˈɪmpækt]n.
An impact is the effect someone or something has on another. (Tác động là ảnh hưởng mà một người hoặc một vật gây ra cho người/vật khác.)
→ My grandmother had a great impact on my life.
😎
lure[lʊr]v.
To lure someone is to convince them to do something, by using a trick. (Dụ dỗ ai đó là thuyết phục họ làm điều gì đó bằng cách sử dụng mánh khóe.)
→ The store lures people in with big signs that say “Sale!”
😎
obstacle[ˈɑːbstəkl]n.
An obstacle is an object or a problem that stops you from doing something. (Chướng ngại vật là một vật thể hoặc một vấn đề ngăn cản bạn làm điều gì đó.)
→ Climbing over the giant rock was the biggest obstacle for the hikers.
😎
shelter[ˈʃeltər]n.
A shelter is a place to go that is safe from danger or bad weather. (Nơi trú ẩn là nơi an toàn giúp tránh khỏi nguy hiểm hoặc thời tiết xấu.)
→ The frog took shelter from the storm in a nearby cave.
😎
sort[sɔːrt]v.
To sort means to separate things into different groups or classes. (Phân loại có nghĩa là tách các vật thành các nhóm hoặc lớp khác nhau.)
→ He sorted his clothes by colors and sizes.
😎
supply[səˈplaɪ]v.
To supply something means to give people what they need or want. (Cung cấp điều gì đó có nghĩa là mang đến cho mọi người những gì họ cần hoặc muốn.)
→ The water heater supplied the house with warm water.
😎
vain[veɪn]adj.
If people are vain, they are only concerned with how they look. (Nếu mọi người tự phụ/kiêu ngạo, họ chỉ quan tâm đến vẻ bề ngoài của mình.)
→ Rebecca is so vain that she looks at herself in every mirror.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the right word for the given definition.

questions.content: 1. to provide the things that someone needs to do something
options: sort
enchant
equip
lure
questions.explanation: equip (v.): trang bị cho ai đó là cung cấp cho họ những thứ cần thiết để làm việc gì đó.

questions.content: 2. a safe place
options: genre
shelter
defense
culture
questions.explanation: shelter (n.): nơi trú ẩn là nơi an toàn khỏi nguy hiểm hoặc thời tiết xấu.

questions.content: 3. holding a weapon
options: authoritative
vain
diverse
armed
questions.explanation: armed (adj.): được trang bị vũ khí, mang theo vũ khí.

questions.content: 4. pieces of information
options: details
impacts
applause
supplies
questions.explanation: details (n.): chi tiết, những mẩu thông tin.

questions.content: 5. a group working together
options: ceremony
alliance
exception
obstacle
questions.explanation: alliance (n.): liên minh là một nhóm người làm việc cùng nhau.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: 1. Please (put into different groups) all the leaves you find.
options: sort
impact
equip
lure
questions.explanation: sort (v.) đồng nghĩa với 'put into different groups' (phân loại).

questions.content: 2. Everybody was (very interested) when Kate read that beautiful poem out loud.
options: armed
vain
enchanted
diverse
questions.explanation: enchanted (v.) đồng nghĩa với 'very interested' (mê hoặc, thích thú).

questions.content: 3. The performer heard great (sounds of people clapping their hands).
options: defense
applause
alliance
ceremony
questions.explanation: applause (n.) đồng nghĩa với 'sounds of people clapping their hands' (tiếng vỗ tay).

questions.content: 4. Tim takes a long time to get ready because he is so (concerned with how he looks).
options: vain
authoritative
diverse
armed
questions.explanation: vain (adj.) đồng nghĩa với 'concerned with how he looks' (tự phụ, kiêu ngạo, chú trọng vẻ bề ngoài).

questions.content: 5. Ocean life is made up of a (wide variety of things).
options: vain
diverse
authoritative
armed
questions.explanation: diverse (adj.) đồng nghĩa với 'wide variety of things' (đa dạng).

questions.content: 6. What is your favorite (kind or style) of music?
options: obstacle
genre
culture
shelter
questions.explanation: genre (n.) đồng nghĩa với 'kind or style' (thể loại).

questions.content: 7. The (special event) will start at 8 o’clock tonight.
options: alliance
defense
exception
ceremony
questions.explanation: ceremony (n.) đồng nghĩa với 'special event' (buổi lễ, sự kiện đặc biệt).

questions.content: 8. The city’s only (action taken to protect itself) was to build a giant brick wall around it.
options: defense
impact
obstacle
detail
questions.explanation: defense (n.) đồng nghĩa với 'action taken to protect itself' (phòng thủ, bảo vệ).

questions.content: 9. Ben went through many (problems) before he finished his project.
options: obstacles
supplies
alliances
ceremonies
questions.explanation: obstacles (n.) đồng nghĩa với 'problems' (chướng ngại vật, vấn đề).

questions.content: 10. Most girls like to play with dolls, but Samantha is the one who (doesn’t conform).
options: exception
genre
culture
applause
questions.explanation: exception (n.) đồng nghĩa với 'the one who doesn’t conform' (ngoại lệ).

sections.title: Exercise 3: Match the phrases and clauses to make complete sentences.

questions.content: 1. I’m going to try to lure my friends ____.
options: into coming to the museum with me
into three equal groups
was not being able to read very well
was popularized by artists like Picasso and Dali
questions.explanation: lure (dụ dỗ) bạn bè đi đến bảo tàng.

questions.content: 2. Sort the pieces ____.
options: into coming to the museum with me
into three equal groups
was not being able to read very well
was popularized by artists like Picasso and Dali
questions.explanation: sort (phân loại) các mảnh thành ba nhóm bằng nhau.

questions.content: 3. The biggest obstacle Mary faced ____.
options: into coming to the museum with me
into three equal groups
was not being able to read very well
was popularized by artists like Picasso and Dali
questions.explanation: obstacle (trở ngại) lớn nhất của Mary là không đọc tốt.

questions.content: 4. The genre of abstract art ____.
options: into coming to the museum with me
into three equal groups
was not being able to read very well
was popularized by artists like Picasso and Dali
questions.explanation: genre (thể loại) nghệ thuật trừu tượng được phổ biến bởi các nghệ sĩ như Picasso và Dali.

questions.content: 5. The awards ceremony is ____.
options: tonight at the Royal Crown Hotel
known for its interesting folk art
is to wear a lot of sunscreen
with pencils, scissors, and a lot of glue
questions.explanation: ceremony (buổi lễ) trao giải diễn ra vào tối nay tại khách sạn Royal Crown.

questions.content: 6. Mexican culture is ____.
options: tonight at the Royal Crown Hotel
known for its interesting folk art
is to wear a lot of sunscreen
with pencils, scissors, and a lot of glue
questions.explanation: culture (văn hóa) Mexico nổi tiếng với nghệ thuật dân gian thú vị.

questions.content: 7. The best defense against skin cancer ____.
options: tonight at the Royal Crown Hotel
known for its interesting folk art
is to wear a lot of sunscreen
with pencils, scissors, and a lot of glue
questions.explanation: defense (phòng thủ) tốt nhất để chống ung thư da là thoa nhiều kem chống nắng.

questions.content: 8. The students were equipped ____.
options: tonight at the Royal Crown Hotel
known for its interesting folk art
is to wear a lot of sunscreen
with pencils, scissors, and a lot of glue
questions.explanation: equip (trang bị) cho học sinh bút chì, kéo và nhiều hồ dán.

questions.content: 9. An armed man ran into ____.
options: the jewelry store and stole diamonds
talk about herself for hours and hours
with pencils, scissors, and a lot of glue
is to wear a lot of sunscreen
questions.explanation: Một người đàn ông có vũ trang (armed) lao vào cửa hàng trang sức và ăn trộm kim cương.

questions.content: 10. The vain woman could ____.
options: the jewelry store and stole diamonds
talk about herself for hours and hours
with pencils, scissors, and a lot of glue
is to wear a lot of sunscreen
questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ kiêu ngạo (vain) có thể nói về bản thân hàng giờ liền.

questions.content: 11. It started raining really hard, ____.
options: so we ran inside for shelter
so he supplied them with blankets
and officer Jones is no exception
because he sounds authoritative when he speaks
questions.explanation: Trời mưa rất to nên chúng tôi chạy vào trong để trú ẩn (shelter).

questions.content: 12. He saw that the children were cold, ____.
options: so we ran inside for shelter
so he supplied them with blankets
and officer Jones is no exception
because he sounds authoritative when he speaks
questions.explanation: Anh ấy thấy những đứa trẻ bị lạnh, vì vậy anh ấy đã cung cấp (supplied) chăn cho chúng.

questions.content: 13. Police officers work very hard, ____.
options: so we ran inside for shelter
so he supplied them with blankets
and officer Jones is no exception
because he sounds authoritative when he speaks
questions.explanation: Các sĩ quan cảnh sát làm việc rất chăm chỉ, và sĩ quan Jones cũng không phải là ngoại lệ (exception).

questions.content: 14. Everyone always trusts Seth ____.
options: so we ran inside for shelter
so he supplied them with blankets
and officer Jones is no exception
because he sounds authoritative when he speaks
questions.explanation: Mọi người luôn tin tưởng Seth vì giọng anh ấy nghe có vẻ rất có thẩm quyền (authoritative) khi nói.

questions.content: 15. Mother Teresa was a very well-known person, ____.
options: and her work impacted many lives
but I like a diverse selection
but it had so many details that he couldn't finish
but everyone else is enchanted by her
questions.explanation: Mẹ Teresa là một người rất nổi tiếng, và công việc của bà đã tác động (impacted) đến nhiều cuộc đời.

questions.content: 16. He only likes one type of music, ____.
options: and her work impacted many lives
but I like a diverse selection
but it had so many details that he couldn't finish
but everyone else is enchanted by her
questions.explanation: Anh ấy chỉ thích một loại nhạc, nhưng tôi thích sự lựa chọn đa dạng (diverse) hơn.

questions.content: 17. James tried to write the report last night, ____.
options: and her work impacted many lives
but I like a diverse selection
but it had so many details that he couldn't finish
but everyone else is enchanted by her
questions.explanation: James đã cố gắng viết báo cáo vào đêm qua, nhưng nó có quá nhiều chi tiết (details) khiến anh ấy không thể hoàn thành.

questions.content: 18. I don’t really like Jennifer, ____.
options: and her work impacted many lives
but I like a diverse selection
but it had so many details that he couldn't finish
but everyone else is enchanted by her
questions.explanation: Tôi không thực sự thích Jennifer, nhưng mọi người khác đều bị cô ấy mê hoặc (enchanted).

questions.content: 19. Bob and Eric both want to beat James at the game, ____.
options: so they will form an alliance
and the crowd gave him great applause
and her work impacted many lives
but I like a diverse selection
questions.explanation: Cả Bob và Eric đều muốn đánh bại James trong trò chơi, vì vậy họ sẽ thành lập một liên minh (alliance).

questions.content: 20. The performer did a great job, ____.
options: so they will form an alliance
and the crowd gave him great applause
and her work impacted many lives
but I like a diverse selection
questions.explanation: Người biểu diễn đã làm rất tốt và đám đông đã dành cho anh ấy những tràng pháo tay (applause) nồng nhiệt.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
How a Singer Helped Win the War

Sometimes famous people are vain. They only care about themselves. But Josephine Baker was an exception. In the 1930s and 1940s, Baker was one of the most famous women in France. She was a big part of the new jazz genre and culture and had a diverse group of fans. The French people especially loved her. And she loved France. So when World War II started, she wanted to help the nation that had given her so much.

In 1940, armed German troops entered Paris. When this happened, some French people formed a secret alliance. It was called the French Resistance. The group worked for the defense of France. It helped the European and American armies fight the Germans.

Baker was an important member of the Resistance. She had three jobs. The first was to carry messages to and from other members. The messages were written in code on her sheets of music. The second was to provide shelter and supply goods to Resistance members. It would have been dangerous if the Germans found them.

Baker’s third job was the most important. Baker held concerts for European politicians and army members. She lured them in, promising an entertaining show. She enchanted them with her singing and dancing and got lots of applause.

But Baker was always equipped with a small notebook at these concerts. She listened for details about the war and wrote them down. Baker sorted the details and gave authoritative reports to the Resistance.

Some thought Baker’s fame would be an obstacle. The Germans knew who she was, but they didn’t think she was smart enough to work for the Resistance. So she could get information from the Germans easily. This helped the Resistance and the French army save lives and win the war.

Baker had a big impact on the Resistance’s work. She got many awards for her help. When she died, the army had a special ceremony to thank her again for her bravery.

questions.content: 1. Which is true about Josephine Baker's first job for the Resistance?
options: Baker’s first job was to carry messages written in code to and from European politicians.
Baker’s first job was to carry messages written in code to and from Resistance members.
Baker's first job was to provide shelter.
Baker's first job was to supply goods.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào bài đọc: 'The first was to carry messages to and from other members. The messages were written in code on her sheets of music.'

questions.content: 2. Which genre of music was Josephine Baker famous for?
options: She was famous for jazz music.
She was famous for blues music.
She was famous for rock music.
She was famous for country music.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào bài: 'She was a big part of the new jazz genre and culture'.

questions.content: 3. What happened when the Germans entered Paris?
options: Armed soldiers fought them.
Baker lured them back to Germany.
The French formed a secret alliance.
They sent messages in code.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào bài: 'In 1940, armed German troops entered Paris. When this happened, some French people formed a secret alliance.'

questions.content: 4. What was Baker’s most important job?
options: To provide shelter
To give authoritative reports
To write messages in code
To have a diverse group of fans
questions.explanation: Dựa vào bài: 'Baker’s third job was the most important... Baker sorted the details and gave authoritative reports to the Resistance.'

questions.content: 5. What happened when Baker died?
options: The army had a special ceremony.
Baker had an impact on France.
Her fame became an obstacle.
The Resistance found her secret codes.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào đoạn cuối: 'When she died, the army had a special ceremony to thank her again for her bravery.'
